def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    from collections import Counter
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    # The rare non-background color marks a template; most common color is its background.
    bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rare=[v for v in counts if v!=bg and v not in (0,)]
    # Marker may be a color different from background; use the least frequent non-bg color.
    if not rare: return out
    mark=min(rare,key=lambda v:counts[v])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==mark]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts}; sh,sw=max(r for r,c in shape)+1,max(c for r,c in shape)+1
    for dr in range(h-sh+1):
        for dc in range(w-sw+1):
            cells=[(dr+r,dc+c) for r,c in shape]
            if all(grid[r][c]==bg for r,c in cells):
                for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=mark
    return out
PY
